points: Take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah; then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim. This is what Peter would have had to read to them, to convince them that the cleansing of the northern kingdom was going to happen and they would be brought back in.

note.label: Acts 10 Reloaded: Call No Man Common

points: This is the border by which the land is inherited according to the twelve tribes of Israel, and Joseph shall have two portions.

note.label: Ezekiel 47: The Waters Issuing from the House

points: Seek the Lord and ye shall live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph and devour it, and there be none to quench it in Bethel. If you worship these other gods and visit these other cities, the Lord will throw down everything.

note.label: Amos 5: Seek Ye Me and Ye Shall Live

points: Hate the evil and love the good, and establish judgment in the gate; it may be that the Lord God of hosts will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.

note.label: Amos 5: Seek Ye Me and Ye Shall Live

points: They chant to the sound of the viol, invent to themselves instruments of music like David, drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments, but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.

note.label: Amos 6: Woe to Them That Are at Ease in Zion

points: Christ came to Sychar, a city of Samaria near the parcel of ground Jacob gave to his son Joseph, where Jacob's well was. The woman at the well was northern kingdom, Ephraim and Manasseh's land.

note.label: The Dividing Hatred: the Grafted in Strangers

points: He must needs go through Samaria, and comes to Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph. Joseph was the father of Ephraim and Manasseh, so this is northern kingdom ground.

note.label: John 4: The Woman at the Well and the Nobleman's Son

points: The patriarchs is the fathers. How are they able to quote this during the time of the acts of the apostles? Because they were reading what was written afore time in the Old Testament. No new thing under the sun; that's what King Solomon said. This is the works of the apostles during the time of Rome, quoting something that happened way back during the time of Jacob and Joseph.

Envy caused Joseph's brothers to persecute the person that God appointed to save them. Because we don't know who's who, cuz we all believe in regeneration. These same other camps that hate our guts, they believe in regeneration as well, because that's scriptural. You don't know if it's King David that you calling a gay or a, you don't know if it's Solomon back on the earth, Samuel, Hezekiah, Zephaniah, Paul, Peter, John the Revelator back today. These same people that you hating on, those are the prophets of the Lord, and you just don't know.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

points: “Of the tribe of Zabulon were sealed twelve thousand”: from Guatemala down towards Panama, the Mayans. “Of the tribe of Joseph”: people get simple and say it says Joseph, not Ephraim, but Joseph makes reference to Ephraim. “Of the tribe of Benjamin”: the so-called West Indians, Jamaica, Trinidad, the Bahamas. We never taught that the twelve tribes are only in the Western Hemisphere; that is a narrative they are trying to put out there.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 7 Sealing The 144k

points: Joseph in the time of his distress kept the commandment and was made lord of Egypt. Thrown in the hole, sold, bound in prison, and he fled the act of adultery from Potiphar's wife like fleeing from the face of a serpent.
